description: Pump model configuration for separated device tables. Header controllers, chillers, and pumps are stored independently and joined by sample_time plus group_id.

header_controller.formula: Q_total = sum(flow_value of all running header controllers with the same sample_time and group_id)

chiller.formula: Q_total = sum(flow_value of all running chillers with the same sample_time and group_id)

equal_after_speed_ratio_check.description: Before equal allocation, check all running pumps in the same group. If max(w)-min(w) is greater than 0.02, discard this group/time sample.

equal.description: Allocate total group flow equally to all running pumps.

by_speed_ratio.description: Allocate total group flow by each running pump speed ratio. Use this when parallel pumps run at different frequencies and pump models are similar.

by_rated_flow_speed.description: Allocate total group flow by rated flow and speed ratio. Use this when parallel pumps have different rated flow values.
by_rated_flow_speed.formula: Q_i = Q_total * rated_flow_i * w_i / sum(rated_flow_j * w_j)

pump_groups.name: Chilled water pump group 1
pump_groups.description: Chilled-water side: read one total-header flow point, then allocate Q_total to running chilled-water pumps.

pump_groups.name: Cooling water pump group 1
pump_groups.description: Cooling-water side: sum flow points from each cooling facility, then allocate Q_total to running cooling-water pumps.

flow_source.formula: Q_total = sum(flow of running cooling facilities)

calculation_steps: Select a time range in the frontend.
Traverse header-controller rows first, then chiller rows.
For each source type, group rows by sample_time and group_id.
Sum all running source-device flow_value rows in the same sample_time and group_id to get Q_total.
Find running pumps from pump_device_values with the same sample_time and group_id.
Read each pump speed ratio w directly from pump_device_values.speed_ratio.
If more than one pump is running and max(w)-min(w) > 0.02, discard this group/time sample.
If the speed-ratio check passes, allocate Q_total equally to all running pumps.
Read each pump head directly from pump_device_values.head.
Calculate each pump efficiency: eta_i = 0.00275 * Q_i * H_i / power_i.

output_schema.description: The calculation layer should normalize both group strategies into this row format before regression.

head_curve.formula: H = a * Q^2 + b * w * Q + c * w^2

efficiency_curve.formula: eta = j * (Q / w)^2 + k * (Q / w) + l
